tradeoffs.loses: On Router the planner is served by catalog 'gpt-4o' instead of the pinned 'gpt-4o-2024-11-20' snapshot (Router reports gpt-4o as gpt-4o-2024-08-06); an older snapshot can read a screenshot differently. Unset RAMP_ROUTER_API_KEY and the pinned snapshot is used again.
tradeoffs.why: APIVLMPlanner pins the dated snapshot gpt-4o-2024-11-20, which Router 404s and the runtime therefore keeps on OpenAI. The map is the only way to route the default planner without editing the model the provider path requests.
